behaviors.name: Total of items with tax
behaviors.does: Adds price times quantity over the items and multiplies the sum by one plus TAX_RATE.

behaviors.name: Discount
behaviors.does: Takes a percent off an amount.

behaviors.name: Receipt line
behaviors.does: Returns `Total: ` and the total written as money.

behaviors.name: Money format
behaviors.does: Writes a number as dollars with two decimals.

interfaces.name: discount(amount, percent)
interfaces.does: returns the amount less the percent
